For habits that need to be done multiple times a week, examples include reading or eating healthy. Choose “Weekly”, then choose a frequency. Set up reminder(s) for a habit Reminders can be very helpful as well when it comes to developing a habit. Tap the “+” button and set up to 10 reminders for each habit.
